Name: Spouse Surprise
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
Daily Spouse Gifts
[heading]Description[/heading]
Make married life a little more rewarding with [b]Daily Spouse Gifts[/b].
Once you are married, your spouse will give you [b]one surprise gift every day[/b] when you talk to them. The gift is selected from a balanced collection of useful, valuable, and rare items, giving you something new to look forward to each day.
Common items are more likely to appear, while valuable and rare rewards are intentionally less common. This keeps the system fun and useful without turning every morning into a guaranteed jackpot.
The gift is available [b]once per day per spouse[/b] and resets automatically on the next morning. Talking to your spouse multiple times on the same day will not give additional gifts.
The mod is designed to keep the feature simple and focused while preserving the normal Stardew Valley marriage experience.
[heading]Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b]. [/*]
[*]Download [b]Daily Spouse Gifts[/b]. [/*]
[*]Extract the
[code]DailySpouseGift[/code]folder into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder. [/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Once married, talk to your spouse to receive your daily gift. [/*]
[/list][heading]Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]💝 [b]One spouse gift every day[/b] [/*]
[*]🌅 Gift becomes available again each morning [/*]
[*]🎁 Receive the gift by [b]talking to your spouse[/b] [/*]
[*]🍞 Includes useful everyday items [/*]
[*]💎 Includes valuable items [/*]
[*]✨ Includes rare rewards with lower chances [/*]
[*]🎲 Balanced weighted gift selection [/*]
[*]🚫 No unlimited gift spam from repeated conversations [/*]
[*]❤️ Works with normal married-spouse gameplay [/*]
[*]⚙️ Lightweight and focused on one feature [/*]
[*]🔧 [b]GMCM support[/b] for configuration [/*]
[/list]Gift Variety
The gift pool contains a mixture of different item types, including useful supplies, food, resources, ores, gems, and other valuable items.
Common rewards are more frequent, while high-value rewards such as rare resources and extremely valuable items have significantly lower chances.
This means most gifts remain useful and reasonable, while occasional rare rewards make the daily interaction more exciting.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/b] [/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.5.1 or later[/b] [/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] is optional [/*]
[/list]No Content Patcher or additional frameworks are required

One day. One conversation. One surprise gift. 💝
